summary: Haugesund Sparebank, a savings bank, provides various financial products and services to individuals and corporate customers in Norway. Offers current, deposit, and personal accounts, as well as mortgage, 55 percent, construction, fixed-rate, cottage, car, consumer, and framework loans; refinancing of mortgages and consumer debt; and loans for motorcycles, motorhomes, boats, and ATVs. It also provides ATMs, debit and credit cards, mobile payment, mobile and online banking, and in-store cash services; car, travel, home, contents, child, electric scooter, dog, and valuables insurance products; and savings and retirement solutions. The company was incorporated in 1928 and is based in Haugesund, Norway.
